title: Global Menu on Panel in one activity makes windows in other Activities have no in-window menus
line: Apps opened on an activity without a Global Menu widget now show their own menubar again.
explanation: Every Global Menu widget registered org.kde.kappmenuview as soon as it existed, whatever activity it was on, and the appmenu kded module then started the session-wide com.canonical.AppMenu.Registrar. Qt apps check for that registrar when they start and, if it is there, hide their menubar and export it instead, so apps opened on an activity without a Global Menu had no menu at all. The applet now only counts towards registering the service while its containment is on the current activity (panels and containments without an activity always count), and re-checks on activity switches, so apps started on other activities keep their in-window menubar.

commits.message:
applets/appmenu: only provide the global menu on the activity it is on

A Global Menu widget on one activity's desktop made apps started on any
other activity hide their menubar, leaving them with no menu at all. The
applet now only registers the menu view while it is on the current one.

BUG: 412923

media.caption: Default activity: Global Menu widget on its desktop only
Second activity (no Global Menu): Dolphin with its menubar enabled shows no menu, only the hamburger button
Default activity: the Global Menu still shows Dolphin's menu
Second activity: Dolphin started there shows its own menubar
